newsitem.title: USA: ADVISORY - API, EIA, AGA data release schedule.
newsitem.headline: ADVISORY - API, EIA, AGA data release schedule.

text.p: The American Petroleum Institute said that due to the Presidents' Day holiday on Monday, Feb 17, its weekly national petroleum report, which is usually issued on Tuesdays, will be delayed one day to Wednesday, Feb 19, after 1600 EST (2100 GMT).
The Energy Information Administration said its weekly U.S. petroleum data, usually issued on Wednesday, will also be delayed one day, to Thursday, Feb 20, at 0900 EST (1400 GMT).
The American Gas Association said its weekly natural gas underground storage data will be released as normal, on Wednesday, Feb 19, after 1600 EST (2100 GMT).
